item.title: Wildfire alert in the Western U.S. reaches its highest level
item.description: Wildfires have now scorched four million acres of land in the U.S. Federal fire managers say all of the country's resources are currently deployed to major fires.

item.title: Democrats in Maine formally nominate Troy Jackson as their new candidate for U.S. Senate
item.description: Democrats are hoping to move past Graham Platner's scandal-plagued campaign as they look to unseat Susan Collins. In Jackson, they chose a nominee with a similar economic populist message as Platner.
